segments.text: AK-47为什么能连续循环？关键不只是火力，而是内部这套自动复位机构。子弹出膛后，火药气体推动活塞和枪机组向后，退掉空弹壳、压倒击锤，再由复进簧把下一发送回枪膛。接下来按画面拆开这条链路。先记住。
segments.english_text: Why can the AK-47 keep cycling? The key is its self-resetting mechanism. After the bullet leaves the barrel, gas drives the piston and bolt group rearward to extract the case and cock the hammer, then the recoil spring sends the next round into the chamber. We will follow that chain step by step. Keep it in mind.

segments.text: 整枪看起来并不复杂：枪管负责让弹头获得方向，机匣承载运动部件，弹匣负责持续供弹，枪托和握把则让射手能稳定控制。真正决定它能不能连发的，是上方的枪机框、枪机、导气活塞，以及后方那根复进簧。后面每个部件都围绕它工作。
segments.english_text: The rifle looks simple. The barrel guides the bullet, the receiver carries the moving parts, the magazine feeds the ammunition, and the stock and grip help the shooter control it. The parts that make repeated fire possible are the bolt carrier, bolt, gas piston, and recoil spring. Every later part works around this chain.

segments.text: 从枪口向后看，前准星和导气座位于枪管前段，护木包住发热部位，也让射手不会直接碰到枪管。机匣上方的防尘盖并不是承受闭锁压力的核心，真正承受压力的是枪管尾部和机匣前端的闭锁区域。先把承压和导热分开看。再看机械动作。
segments.english_text: Looking from the muzzle rearward, the front sight and gas block sit near the front of the barrel. The handguard covers the hot parts and protects the shooter. The dust cover is not the main pressure-bearing locking surface; that work is done by the barrel rear and the front locking area of the receiver. Separate pressure-bearing parts from heat-management parts. Then watch the mechanical motion.

segments.text: 导气系统先记住一个动作：子弹还在向前飞时，枪管里的部分高压燃气从导气孔进入导气座和导气管。它不会把整把枪向后顶，而是把一股短促的力量送到活塞，再带动枪机组完成后续动作。取气位置决定它什么时候开始动作。这是起点。
segments.english_text: Remember one action in the gas system. While the bullet is still moving forward, some high-pressure gas leaves the barrel through the gas port and enters the gas block and tube. It does not simply push the whole rifle backward; it delivers a short impulse to the piston, which drives the bolt group. The gas-port position determines when the action begins. This is the starting point.

segments.text: 机匣就是这套循环的轨道和外壳。枪机框沿着机匣导轨前后移动，枪机则装在枪机框里面，既要抓住弹药，也要在正确位置旋转闭锁。侧面的拉机柄与枪机框相连，所以手动拉动它，就能看到整套机构被带动。这条导轨关系非常关键。
segments.english_text: The receiver is both the shell and the track for the cycle. The bolt carrier moves along its rails, while the bolt sits inside it and must both handle the cartridge and rotate into the locked position. The charging handle is connected to the carrier, so pulling it moves the whole mechanism. This rail relationship is crucial.

segments.text: 枪机前端面对的是三个关键任务：把下一发推入枪膛，用闭锁凸笋锁住枪管尾部，再用抽壳钩抓住弹壳底部的凹槽。后退时，它还要把击发后的弹壳带出来。一个零件同时参与供弹和退壳，这就是自动步枪的核心效率。两个方向都不可少。
segments.english_text: The bolt face has three key jobs: push the next round into the chamber, lock into the rear of the barrel with its lugs, and grip the case rim with the extractor. On the way back, it also brings out the fired case. One compact assembly serves both feeding and extraction, which is the heart of an automatic rifle. Both directions are needed.

segments.text: 扳机组决定什么时候释放能量。扳机通过阻铁控制击锤，击锤被弹簧压向前方，但在扣扳机前被阻铁挂住。扣下扳机后，阻铁让开，击锤打向击针；而枪机还没有完全闭锁时，机构必须阻止击针提前起作用。这就是保险的边界。
segments.english_text: The trigger group decides when energy is released. The trigger controls the sear, which holds the spring-loaded hammer. Pulling the trigger releases the hammer to strike the firing pin. The mechanism must prevent the firing pin from acting before the bolt is fully locked. This is the boundary of the safety.

segments.text: 这套保险和扳机机构的价值，不是让步枪变得更复杂，而是把危险动作限制在正确时机。枪机向前、弹药到位、闭锁完成之后，击发链路才真正接通。换句话说，能不能开火，首先取决于枪机是否已经把枪膛关严。时机比零件更重要。
segments.english_text: The safety and trigger mechanisms do not exist to add complexity; they restrict dangerous actions to the correct moment. Only after the bolt moves forward, the cartridge is seated, and locking is complete can the firing chain connect. Whether the rifle can fire first depends on whether the chamber is closed. Timing matters more than parts.

segments.text: 闭锁凸笋是枪机前端突出的金属肩，它们会进入枪管尾部对应的凹槽。枪机框继续向前时，内部的凸轮轨迹迫使枪机旋转，凸笋就像门闩一样卡住枪膛。发射时，压力先被这组金属配合接住，而不是由复进簧硬顶住。锁住才闭合。
segments.english_text: The locking lugs are the metal shoulders on the front of the bolt. They enter matching recesses at the rear of the barrel. As the carrier moves forward, its cam path rotates the bolt, and the lugs lock the chamber like a door bolt. During firing, pressure is held by this metal engagement, not by the recoil spring. The chamber closes only when locked.

segments.text: 再看枪机框和枪机的关系：枪机框负责带着活塞长距离往返，枪机则在枪机框内部完成旋转。两者不是完全独立的滑块，而是靠凸轮面互相约束。这样一来，直线后退就能先转动枪机解锁，直线前进又能把它重新锁上。轨迹完成配合。
segments.english_text: Now look at the relationship between the carrier and the bolt. The carrier carries the piston through a long rearward and forward stroke, while the bolt rotates inside the carrier. They are constrained by cam surfaces. Straight rearward motion can rotate and unlock the bolt, and straight forward motion can lock it again. The cam paths create the coordination.

segments.text: 扣下扳机时，击锤从待击位置释放，击针撞击底火，底火再点燃弹壳里的发射药。燃烧产生的气体同时做两件事：一部分推动弹头沿膛线前进，另一部分稍后进入导气系统，给自动循环提供动力。因此一次爆炸能接上下一次循环。循环开始。
segments.english_text: When the trigger is pulled, the hammer leaves its cocked position and the firing pin strikes the primer. The primer ignites the propellant. The expanding gas does two jobs: part of it drives the bullet along the rifling, and another part later enters the gas system to power the automatic cycle. That is how one explosion connects to the next cycle. The cycle starts here.

segments.text: 在子弹还没有离开枪口之前，枪膛必须保持密闭。弹壳在压力下向外膨胀，贴住弹膛壁，枪机底面支撑住弹壳底部。这个密封既保护射手，也把更多能量留给弹头和导气系统。密封先保证安全，导气再提供动力。这一步不能省略。
segments.english_text: Before the bullet leaves the muzzle, the chamber must remain sealed. Pressure expands the case against the chamber wall, while the bolt face supports the case head. This seal protects the shooter and keeps more energy available for the bullet and the gas system. The seal provides safety first, and the gas system provides power. This step cannot be skipped.

segments.text: 接下来进入自动步枪最关键的分界点：发射完成，枪机不能立刻后退。它必须先等压力下降，再通过枪机框的凸轮轨迹旋转解锁。否则弹壳仍被高压顶在枪膛里，强行开锁会把整个机构推到危险状态。这步是退壳前提。别跳过。
segments.english_text: Now comes the critical transition. After firing, the bolt cannot move fully rearward at once. Pressure must fall first, and the carrier cam path must rotate the bolt to unlock it. If the case is still under high pressure, forcing the action open would put the whole mechanism in a dangerous state. This step is the precondition for extraction. Do not skip it.

segments.text: 弧形弹匣不是为了好看。七点六二乘三十九毫米弹药的弹壳带有明显锥度，弹匣顺着这种几何形状弯曲，才能让多发弹药稳定排列。弹匣内部的托弹板和弹簧，始终把最上面一发顶到枪机的运动路径上。所以弹匣曲线和弹药形状是配套的。
segments.english_text: The curved magazine is not just for looks. The 7.62 by 39 millimeter case is strongly tapered, so the magazine follows that geometry to keep multiple rounds aligned. Inside, the follower and spring keep the top round in the path of the moving bolt. The magazine curve and cartridge shape are designed together.

segments.text: 弹匣送上来的不是一整排一起移动，而是每次只交出最上面的一发。枪机向前时，枪机底部越过弹匣口，把这发弹药从弹匣唇口剥离，再沿着供弹路径推向枪膛。下一发则由弹簧补到同一个位置。供弹的节奏由弹簧不断补位。
segments.english_text: The magazine does not move the whole column at once; it presents only the top round. As the bolt moves forward, its lower surface passes the magazine lips, strips the round from the feed position, and pushes it toward the chamber. The spring raises the next round into the same position. The spring keeps restoring the feeding position.

segments.text: 当枪机组处在后方时，弹匣已经把下一发准备好。复进簧被压缩，枪机框获得向前的储备力量；枪机底部先接触弹头后方，再把整发弹药推离弹匣。这个动作看似简单，却必须保证弹头、弹壳和枪膛轴线对齐。复进簧力量要合适。
segments.english_text: When the bolt group is at the rear, the magazine has already prepared the next round. The recoil spring is compressed and stores forward energy. The bottom of the bolt first contacts the rear of the bullet and pushes the cartridge out of the magazine. The bullet, case, and chamber axis must stay aligned. The recoil spring force must be appropriate.

segments.text: 供弹开始，弹头沿着枪膛轴线向前，弹壳底部则被枪机面托住。枪机继续前进，弹药完全进入枪膛，抽壳钩同时扣住弹壳底部的环形凹槽。到这一步，下一发已经不再只是被推着走，而是被枪机接管。这就是从弹匣到枪膛的交接。
segments.english_text: Feeding begins as the bullet moves forward along the bore axis while the bolt face supports the case head. The cartridge enters the chamber and the extractor catches the groove at its base. At this point, the round is no longer merely being pushed; it is controlled by the bolt. This is the handoff from magazine to chamber.

segments.text: 枪机前进到位后，凸轮轨迹让它旋转，闭锁凸笋进入机匣前端的锁定凹槽。枪机框还在继续向前，但枪机已经完成旋转闭锁。击针位于枪机组件内部，只有这一步完成，击发才不会发生在半开状态。闭锁完成后，机构才允许继续击发。
segments.english_text: When the bolt reaches the front, the cam path rotates it and the locking lugs enter the locking recesses at the front of the receiver. The carrier continues forward, but the bolt has completed its rotation and lock. The firing pin is inside the bolt assembly, so firing must wait for this step. Only after locking can the mechanism continue to firing.

segments.text: 击发发生在枪膛已经闭锁之后。击锤打击击针，击针撞到底火，发射药燃烧并把弹头推过膛线。膛线让弹头旋转起来，提升飞行稳定性；而枪机、弹壳和枪管，则在这一瞬间承受压力。这里没有电子控制，只有机械时序。此刻。
segments.english_text: Firing occurs only after the chamber is locked. The hammer strikes the firing pin, the primer ignites the propellant, and the bullet is pushed through the rifling. The rifling spins the bullet for stability, while the bolt, case, and barrel contain the pressure. There is no electronic control here, only mechanical timing.  Now.

segments.text: 高压火药气体先推动弹头向前，再在弹头经过导气孔后，把一部分能量送入导气系统。这里的关键不是气体越多越好，而是取气时机和压力必须足够推动枪机组，又不能让运动部件撞击过猛。这也是导气式武器最关键的取舍。时机要对。
segments.english_text: High-pressure propellant gas first drives the bullet forward. After the bullet passes the gas port, part of that energy enters the gas system. The point is not to use as much gas as possible, but to take it at the right time and pressure: enough to move the bolt group without making the impacts excessive. This is the key trade-off in a gas-operated weapon. The timing must be right.

segments.text: 导气孔把燃气引到枪管上方的导气座，燃气进入导气管后作用在活塞端面。活塞与枪机框相连，所以它不是短促地敲一下就停，而是带着枪机框一起向后走完整行程。这个结构就是长行程导气活塞。活塞行程和压力窗口必须匹配。
segments.english_text: The gas port sends gas to the gas block above the barrel. The gas enters the tube and acts on the piston face. Because the piston is connected to the carrier, it does not merely tap the carrier and stop; it travels rearward with it through the full stroke. This is a long-stroke gas piston system. The piston stroke must match the pressure window.

segments.text: 长行程活塞开始后退，枪机框也被整体带向后方。最初的一小段运动用于让枪机旋转并解除闭锁，之后枪机才真正带着弹壳后退。先解锁、再抽壳的顺序，是自动步枪能安全循环的时间控制。后退的第一段不是在抽壳，而是在解锁。
segments.english_text: As the long-stroke piston moves rearward, it carries the bolt carrier with it. The first part of the movement rotates the bolt and releases the lock; only afterward does the bolt pull the case rearward. Unlocking before extraction is the timing that makes the cycle safe. The first rearward movement is for unlocking, not extraction.

segments.text: 枪机解锁，闭锁凸笋从凹槽里退出，枪机框继续后退。抽壳钩牢牢抓住弹壳底部，先用一个较慢的初始动作把弹壳从枪膛壁上松开，再随着枪机加速把它向后拉出。先松动再拉出，能减少撕裂弹壳的风险。先松动再拉出，顺序不能反。
segments.english_text: The bolt unlocks as the locking lugs leave their recesses and the carrier continues rearward. The extractor holds the case head. A slower initial motion breaks the case free from the chamber wall, and the accelerating bolt then pulls it rearward. Loosening the case before pulling reduces the risk of tearing it. Loosen it before pulling; the order cannot be reversed.

segments.text: 抽壳钩负责抓住，抛壳机构负责甩出去。弹壳随枪机后退到达抛壳位置后，底部一侧被顶住，另一侧仍被抽壳钩牵着，于是弹壳绕着抽壳钩翻转，从右侧抛壳口飞出。这个翻转动作决定弹壳的离开方向。两步各有分工，缺一不可。
segments.english_text: The extractor grips the case, while the ejector throws it out. When the case reaches the ejection position, one side of its base is struck while the extractor still holds the other side. The case pivots around the extractor and flips out through the ejection port. This pivoting action determines the case's exit direction. The two steps have different roles, and neither can be omitted.

segments.text: 抛壳完成后，枪机组继续向后压缩复进簧，同时把击锤重新压到待击位置。枪机后退到最后端时，弹匣把下一发顶高；如果是连续射击，扳机和击发机构会根据选择状态决定是否进入下一次循环。后方行程同时完成复位和再次装填准备。
segments.english_text: After ejection, the bolt group continues rearward and compresses the recoil spring while recocking the hammer. At the rear of the stroke, the magazine raises the next round. In continuous fire, the trigger and fire-control parts determine whether the next cycle begins. The rearward stroke also resets the mechanism and prepares the next loading cycle.

segments.text: 复进簧现在释放储存的能量，把枪机框和活塞组推回前方。枪机先把下一发从弹匣剥离，随后把弹药送入枪膛，最后沿凸轮轨迹再次旋转闭锁。于是，后退完成退壳，前进完成供弹，整套机构回到待击位置。终点必须闭锁。
segments.english_text: The recoil spring now releases its stored energy and pushes the carrier and piston group forward. The bolt strips the next round from the magazine, chambers it, and rotates into lock along the cam path. The rearward stroke handles extraction and ejection; the forward stroke handles feeding and locking. The forward stroke must end locked.

segments.text: 前准星和后方照门出现在画面里，它们不参与自动循环，却决定射手把枪管指向哪里。准星、照门、枪管和枪托必须处在同一套控制关系中；而真正让武器持续工作的，仍然是看不见的枪机、活塞和弹簧。瞄具不改变循环。
segments.english_text: The front sight and rear sight appear here. They do not drive the automatic cycle, but they determine where the barrel is aimed. The sights, barrel, and stock form the shooter’s control relationship; the hidden bolt, piston, and spring are what keep the weapon cycling. The sights do not change the cycle.

segments.text: 把外部零件重新放回来看，防尘盖、护木、枪托和握把主要承担保护、散热和操控任务。它们的设计服务于内部机构：给枪机留出可靠的运动轨道，给导气系统提供支撑，也让士兵能在复杂环境下快速操作。外壳简单，内部的时序并不简单。
segments.english_text: When the external parts are put back, the dust cover, handguard, stock, and grip mainly protect the mechanism, manage heat, and provide control. Their design serves the internal action by giving the bolt a reliable track, supporting the gas system, and allowing fast handling in difficult environments. The exterior is simple, but the internal timing is not.

segments.text: 这也是AK结构给人的第一印象：零件数量不算少，但每个关键动作都由机械配合完成，也不依赖复杂电子系统。只要弹药、枪膛、导气和枪机之间的时序保持正常，它就能把一次扣扳机转化成一整套连续动作。这也是它耐用的原因之一。
segments.english_text: This is the first impression of the AK design. It has many parts, but the critical actions are handled by mechanical relationships rather than complex electronics. As long as ammunition, chamber, gas system, and bolt timing stay within normal conditions, one trigger pull becomes a complete sequence of motion. This is one reason it lasts.

segments.text: 但可靠不等于永远不会卡。官方操作资料也明确提醒，枪膛里的污物、损伤的弹药，都可能阻碍入膛或抽壳。所谓耐用，真正含义是结构给故障留下了更大的容错空间，而不是可以忽略保养和安全检查。容错空间大，也不能忽视规则。记住这点。
segments.english_text: Reliability does not mean it can never stop. Official operating material notes that debris in the chamber or damaged ammunition can obstruct chambering or extraction. Durability means the design leaves more tolerance for adverse conditions; it does not remove the need for maintenance and safety checks. More tolerance does not mean rules can be ignored. Keep this in mind.

segments.text: 把整套循环压缩成一句话：弹匣托起下一发，枪机把它送进枪膛并旋转闭锁；击锤释放，子弹出膛；燃气推动活塞和枪机框后退，枪机解锁、抽壳、抛壳并压倒击锤；复进簧再把一切推回前方。所有环节必须首尾相接才行。
segments.english_text: In one sentence, the cycle is this: the magazine raises a round, the bolt chambers and locks it; the hammer releases and the bullet exits; gas drives the piston and carrier rearward, the bolt unlocks, extracts, ejects, and recocks the hammer; the recoil spring then pushes everything forward again. Every stage must connect to the next.
